description: The restart after an update, which only a desktop build does — a phone updates through its store. The updater itself has no permission here: the page reaches it only through the core's `check_update` and `install_update`, since the plugin's own `check` takes a proxy from whoever calls it. This is a file of its own rather than two more lines in `default`: the Android build compiles neither plugin, and Tauri's build script resolves every permission identifier against the plugins that were actually compiled. A permission naming one that was not is not ignored, it is an error — which is how the Android job went red on a change that had nothing to do with Android. `platforms` is what keeps this file out of that build.
